purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom construction law profiles that depend on building allowlists. This is static category evidence only; it does not prove construction commit ordering, displayed/charged cost parity, city owner resolution, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredStaticEvidence: exact source mechanic id and currentRows evidence for concrete groups
explicit missingGroups entry for every intended group without exact row evidence
requiredRuntimeProof: displayed and charged cost parity proof
city owner to law-owner correlation proof

conflux-elemental-alignment-build.notes: Conflux construction allowlist must use exact elemental-building group rows and separate elemental-building mapping proof.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any harbor or ocean-themed building name
cove.harbor-infrastructure-extra-build.notes: Cove construction allowlist must use exact market/tavern/pirate infrastructure rows and keep cannon blocked until an exact Cannon-yard row exists.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any dwelling-looking row without generated Core evidence
dungeon.capture-token-dwelling-build.notes: Dungeon dwelling construction remains blocked until exact generated Core dwelling build/upgrade row evidence exists.

fortress-fortification-extra-build.notes: Fortress construction allowlist must use exact fortification and defensive-support source mechanic rows.

forbiddenSubstitutes: external dwelling conversion without exact row evidence
necropolis-deathworks-credit-build.notes: Necropolis construction allowlist must use exact dwelling/converter rows; deathworks credit remains a separate runtime predicate.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any dwelling or growth display name
rampart-mature-dwelling-upgrade.notes: Rampart construction allowlist must use exact matured-dwelling-upgrade row evidence and keep persistent mature state separate.

stronghold-military-extra-build.notes: Stronghold construction allowlist must use exact military group source mechanic rows.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any magic or construct display name
normal construction slot counted as workshop slot
tower-magical-construct-workshop-slot.notes: Tower construction allowlist must use exact magical/construct rows; normal-slot versus workshop-slot behavior remains separate runtime proof.
